header: From first import to first live shift
subheadline: The median is four weeks for a company with 50 technicians, from kick-off to the first day without printed job sheets. You need no developer of your own.

items.title: Import your sites and assets
items.description: Send us a spreadsheet, a customer list or an export from your old system. We map it and return a register to check.

items.title: Set your contracts and SLAs
items.description: Enter response windows, visit frequencies and out-of-hours rates once per contract. The jobs for the rest of the year are then created automatically.

items.title: Run one crew for a week
items.description: Four or five technicians go live first, and the rest work as before. A week shows which checklist fields nobody needs.

items.title: Switch the board over
items.description: The whole team switches on a Monday, and our staff are on the phone for the first two mornings. Paper stays available for two weeks.
